stem: These lines highlight the speaker’s discomfort because they show that —
instruction: Read these lines from the poem.

options.label: F
options.text: the page does not provide the speaker with useful ideas

options.label: G
options.text: the speaker does not feel like writing at that particular moment

options.label: H
options.text: the page appears to be taunting the speaker

options.label: J
options.text: the speaker is unsure where to write his thoughts

visual_elements:
Here it is again,
that ghostly blank page
staring me down,
glaring at me in defiance.
“Here,” the page says, “place your words here.”
